# Results 2026-10-22 — pair/multi baseline @ `1856cdf`

Historical baseline migrated from `PAIR_RESULTS.md`. `flq bench` over real
files from `sample_pack/` (gitignored corpus). Every pair decoded 100% correct
(bit-exact, or audio-exact for FLAC tracks). FLQ @ commit `1856cdf`
(multi-format + raw-fallback + MPEG-2.5 sniff fix). v2 container: joint only
against track 0.

## Multi-track (8 tracks, one .flq)

wav i24 8k + flac i16 44.1k + aiff f32 48k + mp3 128k [modeled] +
ogg vorbis + m4a aac + wav i16 48k + mp3 320k [modeled]
-> **113.84 -> 79.59 MiB (69.9%)**, all 8 tracks recovered exactly.
Joint reasons: different sample rates / no joint coding for lossy kinds.
